gaps.sentence: He is under a lot of ___ at work (PRESS).
gaps.hint: noun needed after 'a lot of'; fixed phrase 'under ___'
gaps.explanation: 'Under pressure' is the fixed phrase; the noun of 'press' is 'pressure'.

gaps.sentence: He lost his job because of his ___ (HONESTY).
gaps.hint: negative noun needed — he lost his job
gaps.explanation: Losing a job implies wrongdoing, so the negative noun 'dishonesty' (dis- + honesty) is needed.

gaps.sentence: The medicine is available without a ___ (PRESCRIBE).
The island is ___ , with no permanent residents (HABIT).
gaps.explanation: 'No permanent residents' shows the negative: uninhabited (un- + inhabited). An adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.sentence: The team played ___ and deserved to win (EXCELLENT).
gaps.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb 'played': excellently (-ly).

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INVENT) of the new engine worked day and night.
gaps.explanation: The person who worked day and night is the inventor; 'invention' is the thing created.
After 'complete' a noun is needed: darkness (-ness noun of 'dark').

gaps.sentence: The treaty will strengthen economic ___ between the two countries (COOPERATE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is followed by a noun: cooperation (-tion noun).
